---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv") |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(
      timestamp,
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    month = format(timestamp, "%B", tz = "UTC"),
    month_num = as.integer(format(timestamp, "%m", tz = "UTC")),
    year = as.integer(format(timestamp, "%Y", tz = "UTC")),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
    )
  )

write_rds(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    min_latitude = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_latitude = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_longitude = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_longitude = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(8, 25),
    ylim = c(47, 55),
    default_crs = st_crs(4326),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck ID",
    caption = "Each color represents an individual duck."
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_minimal()
```
